problem: Write the complex number $z=2-2\text{i}$ in exponential form.
worked_solution:
To write our complex number in the form $z=r{\text{e}}^{\text{i}\theta },$ where $r=|z|$ and $\theta =\operatorname{arg}⁡(z),$ we first calculate $r:$

$$
\begin{aligned}r=|z| & =\sqrt{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{{2}^{2}+(-2)^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{8}=2\sqrt{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, since $z$ lies in the fourth quadrant, we can find the angle $\theta $ as

$$
\begin{aligned}\theta =\operatorname{arg}⁡(z) & =2\pi -|\operatorname{arctan}⁡(\frac{y}{x})| \\  & =2\pi -|\operatorname{arctan}⁡(\frac{-2}{2})| \\  & =2\pi -|\operatorname{arctan}⁡(-1)| \\  & =2\pi -\frac{\pi }{4} \\  & =\frac{7\pi }{4}.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, substituting $r=2\sqrt{2}$ and $\theta =\frac{7\pi }{4}$ into $z=r{e}^{\text{i}\theta },$ we get

$$
z=2\sqrt{2}\,{\text{e}}^{7\pi \text{i}/4}.
$$
